description: Generate retro pixel-text animated GIFs for Slack, Teams, or a PR comment — scrolling marquees, heartbeat pulses, confetti parties, twinkling sparkles — from a bundled pure-stdlib Python script (no PIL, no dependencies, byte-exact deterministic).
